# Installation

## Create and fund an IBKR Pro Account

An IBKR Pro account is required to use the TWS API. If you don't already have one, creat an account below.

Create Account

## Trader Workstation

Download Trader Workstation

## Download the TWS API

> **Warning**
>
> Ensure that the API installs to the C: drive.

Download TWS API

## Configure Trader Workstation Settings

1. Launch TWS

2. Log in

3. Open settings (gear icon in top right)

4. Configure the following:

* Enable "ActiveX and Socket Clients"
* Disable "Read-Only API"
* Verify the "Socket Port" value

![](/docs/_fern-files/_img/c6facfc9100221226e90c189fce7d7614b0228b86c594f644e577e822e65dfd5.webp)

Additional configuration options are detailed [here](/docs/tws-api/doc/tws-settings).

## Additional configuration for Python

If you are using the TWS API with Python, additional configuration is required. Follow the steps found [here](/docs/tws-api/doc/unique-configurations/updating-the-python-interpreter).
